ideas.title: The Impact of Childcare Fraud on Local Communities
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of childcare fraud on local communities, including the financial and emotional toll on families
ideas.angle: The human impact of childcare fraud
questions: What are the effects of childcare fraud on local communities?
How can we prevent childcare fraud?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the need for greater oversight and regulation in the childcare industry
